title: Learning by Examples: Power Grid Steady State Analysis with a Tabular Foundation Model
abstract: arXiv:2610.20462v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Foundation models have shown strong generalization across scientific domains, but their use in power systems remains largely task-specific. We investigate whether a pretrained tabular foundation model (TFM), TabPFN, can serve as a general-purpose neural solver for power grid steady-state analysis. We evaluate the TFM on three tasks: power flow (PF) prediction, N-k contingency screening (NCS), and voltage stability margin (VSM) prediction. We performed experiments on 118- and 2000-bus systems, comparing the TFM against task-specific neural baselines. Without retraining or fine-tuning, the TFM matches or outperforms the best task-specific model in several settings across the three tasks. For 118-bus PF prediction, a variant of the TFM achieves errors of $1\times 10^{-3}$ pu for voltage magnitudes and $0.30^\circ$ for voltage angles, outperforming all baselines. translated_title: 从示例中学习：基于表格基础模型的电网稳态分析
translated_abstract: 基础模型已在多个科学领域展现出强大的泛化能力，但其在电力系统中的应用大多局限于特定任务。我们研究了预训练的表格基础模型（TFM）TabPFN能否作为电网稳态分析的通用神经求解器。我们在三个任务上对该TFM进行了评估：潮流（PF）预测、N-k预想故障筛查（NCS）以及电压稳定裕度（VSM）预测。我们在118节点和2000节点系统上开展了实验，将该TFM与特定任务的神经基线模型进行对比。在无需重新训练或微调的情况下，该TFM在三个任务的多个场景中达到甚至超越了最佳任务特定模型的性能。在118节点系统的潮流预测任务中，TFM的一个变体实现了$1\times 10^{-3}$ pu的电压幅值误差和$0.30^\circ$的电压相角误差，优于所有基线模型。在未见的N-1故障场景以及接近不可行的潮流算例上，该TFM同样表现出较强的竞争力。
tldr: 本研究证明预训练表格基础模型TabPFN无需重新训练或微调，即可作为电网稳态分析（潮流预测、N-k预想故障筛查和电压稳定裕度预测）的通用神经求解器，在多个任务上达到或超越任务特定模型。
en_tdlr: This paper demonstrates that a pretrained tabular foundation model (TabPFN) can serve as a general-purpose neural solver for power grid steady-state analysis—power flow prediction, N-k contingency screening, and voltage stability margin prediction—matching or outperforming task-specific models without retraining or fine-tuning.
